$comment: Single source of the language × domain × agent support matrix. README.md's table is generated from this file by scripts/gen-readme-matrix.ps1 (SupportMatrixReadmeTests keeps them equal); the website copies it. Status changes are reviewed edits; scripts/conformance-report.ps1 -UpdateMatrix only writes evidence.

legend.meaning: a project generated from the scaffolded skills compiles. Every framework API claim in those skills was checked against the current framework source, and the agent's layout is the one already in live use (Claude Code).
READY evidence plus agent conformance (discovery + delegation) passed, but delegation was only exercised on synthetic snapshot fixtures (desktop, mobile) — not yet on a live recording.

the same skills, placed in the agent's documented native layout. The layout is pinned by golden-file tests but has not yet been confirmed live in that IDE/CLI (`docs/LIVE-VERIFICATION-CHECKLIST.md` §A).
the BELLATRIX flavor itself has no layer to generate code against.

notes: No cell is BLOCKED-TOOLCHAIN: .NET, Maven/JDK 19 and Node were available for every compile check.
In no cell have the generated tests been *run* against a live app yet (§C of the live checklist).

agents.name: GitHub Copilot
agents.subagents: `.github/agents/*.agent.md`, with `agents:` allow-list on generators. Reuses `.claude/agents/` when Claude is scaffolded
agents.delegation: Subagent (VS Code `runSubagent`, CLI). Cloud agent: see limits

agents.name: Codex CLI
agents.instructions: One marker block in `AGENTS.md` pointing at `.bellatrix/bellatrix.instructions.md`
agents.delegation: Name the subagent in the prompt. Fallback: `find`

agents.name: Antigravity CLI
agents.delegation: Subagent chosen by the main agent (no `@name` syntax). Fallback: `bellatrix <domain> find`

agents.name: Kiro CLI
agents.subagents: `.kiro/agents/*.md` (v3 Markdown; `resources` list the steering file and skills)
agents.delegation: Subagent named in plain language. Fallback: `find`

agents.name: OpenCode
agents.instructions: One marker block in `AGENTS.md` pointing at `.bellatrix/bellatrix.instructions.md` (shared with Codex)
